claim: Performance Insights keeps performance data history for a default of 7 days, and you can specify 1–24 months to retain it for longer; it is available for all engines except Db2.
question: How long does RDS Performance Insights keep data by default, and how long can it keep it?

qualifiers.scope: per DB instance with Performance Insights
qualifiers.condition: longer retention is charged; see the Database Insights pricing page

note: Performance Insights is now presented as part of CloudWatch Database Insights; the decisions+changes lens should check the current naming and any end-of-life notice.
